confidence_notes: Local surveys support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use local draft beer as a benchmark and were checked against a small sample of July menus. Lodging is modeled for a typical July night, with the greatest uncertainty for private hostel rooms and basic hotels. Prices are before taxes and tips. [June survey](https://www.expatica.com/us/cost-of-living/boston-ma/) · [Current survey](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Boston) · [July menu comparison](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/07/08/lifestyle/boston-affordable-expensive-restaurants/)
comparable_city_reasoning: The lodging estimates reflect Boston's high-cost Northeastern U.S. market, strong July visitor demand and limited central budget lodging.
